news.title: STAT+: Enforcement of stringent Medicaid work requirements delayed for six months
news.summary: Enforcement of the Trump administration's stringent new Medicaid work requirements have been delayed for six months, until July 1, 2027.

news.title: STAT+: Democrats coalesce around ‘Medicare for More,’ ‘Medikids’ proposals
news.summary: Democrats are coalescing around a plan to offer Medicare to more Americans, if not all of them.

news.title: STAT+: Up and down the ladder: The latest comings and goings
news.summary: From new hires to departures, promotions and transfers, here are the latest comings and goings in the pharmaceutical industry.

news.title: STAT+: HHS plans funding for research into ibogaine for PTSD
news.summary: The Trump administration will funnel up to $4.9 million into supporting research into ibogaine, a psychedelic that’s drawn interest as a potential treatment for PTSD and addiction.

news.title: Opinion: New organ donation rules are unfair to families
news.summary: New organ donation rules may “blur the line between the physicians fighting to save a patient's life and the teams responsible for organ procurement.”

news.title: Brain implant startup pauses trials
news.summary: Synchron has paused clinical trials of its second-generation brain-computer interface. Leaders say the pause is not safety related.

news.summary: A deal for smart-ring maker Oura to acquire a telehealth company is raising conflict-of-interest questions for Eli Lilly

news.title: STAT+: Senators introduce bill to curb conflicts of interest on preventive care panel

news.title: Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed on restoring trust in science, the state of public health, and RFK Jr.
news.summary: Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed talks to STAT about restoring trust in science, the state of public health, and RFK Jr.

news.title: STAT+: Oura’s acquisition of health tech startup raises conflict-of-interest questions for Eli Lilly, experts say
news.summary: With a new deal announced this week, the relationship between Eli Lilly and a telehealth company that markets GLP-1s is expected to grow more complicated.

news.title: 5 takeaways from STAT’s investigation of the sprawling ‘three-parent IVF’ industry
news.summary: A STAT investigation of the fertility tourism industry found that clinics are offering an unproven IVF procedure to older women. Here are 5 takeaways from the investigation.

news.title: Opinion: STAT+: ‘What will I do with the time I have left?’: What it’s like to find out you might develop Alzheimer’s
news.summary: “What people fear isn’t the end of life, the demise of the animated body, but the demise of the mind,” writes Jason Karlawish.

news.title: Trump administration delays enforcement of Medicaid work requirements for six months
news.summary: CMS is offering states an optional six-month enforcement grace period for new Medicaid work requirements, allowing them to test and improve eligibility systems without denying or terminating otherwise eligible beneficiaries for noncompliance through June 30, 2027.

news.title: CommonSpirit Health logs $544M operating loss to begin its FY2027
news.summary: The major Catholic nonprofit system said its strong volumes and efficiency gains were hamstrung by weakened payer mix and rising costs.

news.title: Plan sponsor expectations, policy shifts set to pressure payers in 2027
news.summary: 2027 is shaping up to be a complex year for health plans, as demands from clients to demonstrate value get louder, according to a new report.

news.title: Ardent Health acquiring Missouri nonprofit Boone Health for $47M
news.summary: The purchase of the $500 million Missouri nonprofit includes a 10-year, $200 million capital commitment, and is expected to bring Ardent at least $30 million annual EBITDA by its third year.

news.title: Chutes & Ladders—Mayo Clinic names next CEO; Novant Health CEO to retire
news.summary: Welcome to this week's Chutes & Ladders, our roundup of hirings, firings and retirings throughout the industry. Please submit the good news—or the bad—from your shop, and we will feature it here at the end of each week.

news.title: Policy Brief: Trump admin unveils $10B in second-year rural health awards; HHS invests $9.7M to combat elder abuse
news.summary: The latest news from CMS and HHS: RHTP second year funding announced, CMS issues two new key rules and more.

news.title: Patient experience has improved across the healthcare industry. Now comes consistency
news.summary: As metrics like patients' average likelihood to recommend reach or surpass pre-pandemic levels, inconsistency and operational friction are the next hurdles for providers to surmount, according to a new report pulling data from 43.1 million patient encounters.

news.title: Industry Voices—From pledges to progress: Kill the clipboard, keep an eye on consistency
news.summary: Reaching CMS' goal to kill the clipboard will require more than voluntary commitments from individual technology developers, writes Altera's Leigh Burchell.

news.title: Dyania Health, Nvidia team up to bring clinical reasoning AI inside hospital networks
news.summary: Dyania Health is teaming up with Nvidia to run its Synapsis AI clinical reasoning platform inside hospitals’ own IT environments, allowing health systems to analyze years of patient records at population scale without sending protected patient data outside their networks.

news.title: Weekly Rundown: Ohio State Wexner, Microsoft ink tech deal; OpenEvidence launches free Access Intelligence tools
news.summary: The latest news from R1, OpenEvidence, Microsoft, Ohio State Wexner Medical Center, Clear, Epic, Ellipsis Health and Kouper Health.

news.title: UnitedHealth releases independent audit of its medical policy development practices
news.summary: Over the past year, UnitedHealth Group has conducted a series of independent reviews of its practices as part of a broader turnaround effort at the company.

news.title: CMS extends moratorium on new Medicare enrollments for hospice, home health agencies
news.summary: The Trump administration is extending its moratorium on new Medicare enrollments from hospice and home health agencies.

news.title: Charles River pays $470M for 2 Frontage bioanalysis labs in Pennsylvania
news.summary: Charles River Laboratories has acquired Tigermed’s Frontage laboratory sites for $470 million upfront to advance its bioanalysis footprint.

news.title: The promise of molecular gates and what comes next
news.summary: Gate Bioscience is developing a new class of medicines designed to eliminate disease-causing proteins at their source. In this episode of "The Top Line," Gate co-founder and CEO Jordi Mata-Fink, Ph.D., discusses the promise of molecular gates, the biotech's expanded partnership with Eli Lilly and its plans to bring the technology into the clinic.

news.title: Rezolute gets an uplift from phase 3 tumor hyperinsulinism win ahead of FDA meeting
news.summary: A phase 3 clinical trial of Rezolute’s ersodetug in tumor hyperinsulinism has hit its primary endpoint, boosting the biotech ahead of a potential filing for FDA approval in another indication.

news.title: Cellectis will shed 70% of workforce as part of in vivo pivot
news.summary: Cellectis’ pivot from allogeneic CAR-Ts to in vivo therapies is set to come at the expense of 70% of its workforce.

news.title: ‘They’ve been misdiagnosed for too long’: Researchers use 10-protein panel to improve ALS detection
news.summary: By the time a neurodegenerative condition has been diagnosed, it's often too late. At the point of detection, the disease may already be causing irreversible damage, fueling an urgent search for ways to identify biological clues earlier and track their progression.

news.title: Chutes & Ladders—Bristol Myers' research chief out amid R&D reorganization
news.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb's research chief is departing as the company restructures R&D. Summit Therapeutics cut ties with multiple launch team members, including its CCO, ahead of a high-stakes FDA decision. And OncoNano appointed its interim chief, a former FDA commissioner, to the permanent CEO spot.

news.title: American Cancer Society updates prostate cancer screening guidance
news.summary: For the first time in 16 years, the American Cancer Society (ACS) has updated its guideline for prostate cancer screening as it drives to boost detection of the disease before it spreads.

news.title: Sanofi-backed Windward hits $225M IPO goal, as Rezera delays listing over ‘market conditions’
news.summary: Windward Bio’s IPO has blown to exactly the spot the Swiss biotech had been aiming for, bringing in $225 million to fund a pair of respiratory drugs licensed from China.

news.title: Fierce Biotech Layoff Tracker 2026: Milestone shrinks HQ workforce during Cardamyst rollout
news.summary: As always, if you know of layoffs occurring at a biotech, please reach out to the Fierce Biotech editorial team.

news.title: Virtuoso Surgical nabs FDA authorization for robotic bladder lesions system
news.summary: The FDA has granted De Novo authorization for Virtuoso Surgical’s Virtuoso Endoscopy System.

news.title: Regeneron posts positive phase 2 data for baloncibart in nervous system disorder, eyes pivotal trial
news.summary: Regeneron has posted positive phase 2 data on baloncibart in postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, teeing the biotech up to start a potentially pivotal trial in the first half of 2027.

news.title: ARPA-H bets $4.9 million on ibogaine for PTSD treatment in veterans
news.summary: The U.S. department of health and human services announced a $4.9 million bet to advance the development of ibogaine for post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD).

papers.title: A frontier machine intelligence for human neuroimaging
papers.summary: Medical imaging is essential for diagnosing disease, guiding treatment and monitoring patients over time. Although artificial intelligence has advanced image interpretation, existing medical models often address restricted tasks, while general-purpose proprietary models lack access to private clinical imaging required to achieve medical expertise. Developing models that can interpret complex examinations and communicate their findings in the context of clinical decisions remains a major challenge.
